registered: 2026-10-20, before any WP2-WP4 output; registered code src/grid15.py and src/variants.py (hashes in wp1/protocol.sha256); machinery checks src/test_wp1.py -> wp1/test_wp1.json (7/7 pass, no current-SUB or probe number computed)

hypothesis_grid.target: T_k(h) = Q_fc,k + eps0 + Delta - f * R_k + d * L_k, L_k = max(0, 100.41 - (Q_fc,k + eps0)), k = 1..7 (round 6 run_wp1.target)

Q_fc_plus_eps0_Ah.source: round 6 wp1_predictions.csv, proxy at Delta = 0.4 minus 0.4 (round-3 harness QFC + EPS0); reproduced independently with the base events.full_charges to 1.4e-14 Ah (test T1)

Delta_axis.rule: replace with round 12's EPS_EXTRA interval only if round 12 reached L1 or L2

d_axis.rule: replace with d_top = d_tail + d_path {lo, median, hi} only if rounds 13 and 14 are both present and identifiable; one present -> combine with round 11's [-0.036, +0.052]; neither present -> keep round 6's axis
d_axis.reason: both present but neither identifiable: the replacement condition fails and neither fallback case applies; round 6's axis is kept (D10)

G_r11.role: readability gate: a probe must also be readable here (conservative resolution of the uncovered d-axis case, D10)

G_env.role: descriptive only (non-identified envelopes of rounds 13 and 14)

metric_family.errors: e_k(h) = SOH_k - 100 * T_k(h) / 102 in pp, SOH_k = the package CLI output (3 decimals), k = 1..7
metric_family.normalised: nMAE = MAE / MAE_EX, nRMSE = RMSE / RMSE_EX, nMAX = MAX / MAX_EX, EX under the same h
metric_family.s: round 6: s = (nMAE + nRMSE + nMAX) / 3 (reproduced to 4e-14 on round 6's 12 candidates x 18 h, test T2)
metric_family.EX: ExampleModel of the base package (my_model/model_example.py, unchanged since cd68ad4 = round 6's archived 21a7a55 copy), run through the package CLI from a research copy whose my_model/__init__.py switch points at ExampleModel (src/variants.py 'EX')

P_A3fix.fact: G_a3 identified: a3_rel = +0.3047 Ah, 4 of 5 locators same sign
P_A3fix.definition: round 12 src/wp4_run.py a3fix_variant(a3_rel = 0.3047028157489251, segment = 6): after the step-to-top distance of the first full charge of segment 6 (anchor 3) is computed, q = q - 0.3047; exact text replacement in the base model_template.py (src/variants.py 'P_A3fix')
P_A3fix.rebuild_check: its CLI SOH must equal round 12's SOH_variants.csv row SUB_A3fix exactly (3 decimals); otherwise it is dropped

P_drift.rule: round 13 or round 14 reached O2; both O1 -> ineligible; neither present -> round 6's d = -0.031
P_drift.fact: both present, both O3: neither reached O2; the 'neither present' fallback does not apply (D11)

P_stress_early.rule: rebuildable on the current SUB from round 6/7 code without new fitting
P_stress_early.fact: dropped (D12): (1) F1_S_B's weight w = sigma_SUB^2 / (q_sd^2 + sigma_S0^2 + sigma_SUB^2) uses sigma_SUB per branch of round 6's SUB (V2 + sqrt t), fitted in round 6 WP2 from that SUB's proxy errors; the current SUB (T_main + A3) has a different gap branch and step estimator, so its sigma_SUB is unknown, and estimating it is new fitting against proxies, which round 15 forbids; reusing the old sigma_SUB is not a rebuild of the registered design. (2) Round 7 did not rebuild it. (3) A package variant would need the round-5C stress law ported into model_template.py, so it is neither a one-scalar change (section 2) nor 'the registered scalar or hook plus a docstring line' (WP3).

variants.P_drift_r6: SUB CLI output transformed by round 6's 3b rule with d = -0.031: Q' = Q + d * max(0, 100.41 - Q)

descriptive_only.role: delta-s, readability and ranking keys are reported in a separate table for context; they never enter the selection

free_information_first.rule: for every leaderboard observation whose package SOH vector is known (wp0/existing_packages.csv or wp3/packages.csv), compute each hypothesis's predicted s, nMAE, nRMSE, nMAX; a hypothesis survives if, for every observation and every shown value, at least one metric predicts the shown value within one unit of its last displayed digit (grid15.surviving)
free_information_first.empty_result: if no hypothesis survives, the grid is reported as inconsistent with the board and the full grid is kept (conservative)
free_information_first.role: filters hypotheses only; never selects a model
free_information_first.at_registration: no observations -> surviving set = full grid

probe_selection.delta_s: delta-s_m(h) = m_h(probe) - m_h(SUB), m in {s, nMAE, nRMSE, nMAX}; negative = the probe beats SUB
probe_selection.readable: sign(delta-s) equal under all four metrics for >= 80 % of the surviving hypotheses, on G_main AND on G_r11
probe_selection.ranking: key1 = max over the four metrics of the uniform expectation of delta-s over the surviving set (the least favourable metric); key2 = max over metrics of the worst-case delta-s; rank by key1, then key2
probe_selection.worth: a readable probe is chosen only if key1 < 0, i.e. it is expected to beat SUB under every metric (D13)
probe_selection.none: if no probe qualifies, the plan is 'no probe; keep SUB'
reported_not_deciding: detectable fraction: all four |delta-s| > 0.005 with one sign
wins: hypotheses where all four delta-s < -0.005

reading_rules.observed_delta: board value of the probe minus board value of SUB, per shown metric, from evaluations of zips whose hashes match wp3/packages.csv (probe) and wp0/existing_packages.csv or wp3/packages.csv (SUB: model_template.py SHA256 3bd26ed8...)
reading_rules.tol: the board's display precision (one unit of the last shown digit of both values); 0.005 if it cannot be read

rules.delta < -tol: adopt the probe's scalar as the new submission candidate
rules.delta > +tol: revert to SUB and drop that hypothesis branch: remove from the surviving set the hypotheses under which every metric of the family predicted delta-s < -tol (a clear predicted win whatever the shown metric is; grid15.drop_branch)

reading_rules.several_metrics: the rule applies to each shown metric; the probe wins only if at least one shown metric improves by more than tol and none gets worse by more than tol
reading_rules.rank_only: a board that shows only ranks carries no information (rank depends on other teams)
reading_rules.prerequisite: SUB's own board value must be known; without it a probe cannot be read

end_state_rule: the last submission before the deadline must be the best observed option, SUB by default; a probe is never left as the last submission unless it won; with evaluations every two weeks and an unknown deadline, assume at most two evaluation cycles remain; after a probe's evaluation is logged, SUB's zip is re-uploaded at once unless the probe won
compliance_rule: at most two probes in total, each a whole-model variant changing one physically motivated scalar produced by a registered earlier round; each probe and any adopted change is disclosed in the README and report; no per-checkup edits; the final model must be justifiable from the physics alone; nothing is uploaded, sent or published by this round (the user performs every external action); the organiser question is a draft only
no_proxy_statement: no error against the proxy labels P_k is reported as accuracy evidence; errors against T_k(h) exist only inside the registered delta-s / predicted-score machinery and are reported only as normalised aggregate scores, never per checkup
